title: On the Effectiveness of Snapshot Testing: An Empirical Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.29549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software testing is essential for ensuring quality, yet testing complex front-end user interfaces is often time-consuming and difficult. Snapshot testing has emerged as a low-cost regression testing method that detects unexpected changes by comparing program behavior before and after modifications. Despite its growing adoption, empirical evidence regarding its actual effectiveness remains scarce. To fill this gap, this study presents a large-scale empirical investigation into the effectiveness of snapshot testing involving 340 GitHub repositories and a survey of 60 experienced practitioners.   Our quantitative results demonstrate that combining snapshot and traditional non-snapshot tests significantly enhances code coverage, achieving a median statement coverage of 86.7%. translated_title: 快照测试有效性研究：一项实证研究
translated_abstract: 软件测试对于保证软件质量至关重要，然而测试复杂的前端用户界面往往耗时且困难。快照测试作为一种低成本的回归测试方法应运而生，它通过比较程序在修改前后的行为来检测意外变化。尽管快照测试的采用日益广泛，但关于其实际有效性的实证证据仍然稀缺。为填补这一空白，本研究对快照测试的有效性开展了大规模实证调查，涉及340个GitHub仓库以及对60位经验丰富从业者的问卷调查。我们的定量结果表明，将快照测试与传统的非快照测试相结合可显著提高代码覆盖率，语句覆盖率中位数达到86.7%。我们发现这两种方法高度互补，通常覆盖生产代码的不同区域。此外，包含快照测试的测试套件（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究对340个GitHub仓库的大规模实证分析及60位从业者的调查表明，快照测试与传统的非快照测试高度互补，两者结合可将语句覆盖率中位数提升至86.7%，显著增强测试有效性。
en_tdlr: This large-scale empirical study of 340 GitHub repositories and a survey of 60 practitioners shows that snapshot testing is highly complementary to traditional non-snapshot testing, and combining them significantly enhances code coverage, achieving a median statement coverage of 86.7%.
